headline: Record fundraising quarter lifts earnings across the board

drivers.explanation: Moves in line with the rise in GAAP net income on a broadly stable share count.
CFO cited many key financial metrics growing more than 20% year over year, attributed to the scale and diversification of the platform.
Reflects the same platform scale and diversification cited by management for broad-based double-digit growth this quarter.
Driven by a record quarter of fundraising with more than $36 billion of inflows, which management attributed to consistent fund performance.
Record inflows and platform scale drove broad-based earnings growth; management cited $170B of dry powder and its largest-ever forward pipeline while calling the transaction environment slower.

summary_short: Ares posted Q2 2026 GAAP net income of $150.6M ($0.49/share), up from $142.6M in Q1, while after-tax realized income reached $467.6M ($1.29/share) and fee related earnings were $491.1M on a record $36B+ of quarterly inflows.
summary_long: GAAP net income rose to $150.6M ($0.49/share) from $142.6M in Q1 2026 and $137.1M a year ago. After-tax realized income was $467.6M ($1.29/share) and fee related earnings were $491.1M, both cited by the CFO as part of broad-based metric growth exceeding 20% year over year, attributed to the platform's scale and diversification. AUM reached over $671B, driven by a record $36B+ of quarterly inflows on strong fund performance. Management cited $170B of dry powder supporting its largest-ever forward investment pipeline, describing the transaction environment as slower but with a pickup in the pipeline underway. No numeric forward guidance was issued. The board declared a $1.35/share Class A common dividend and a $0.84375/share preferred dividend.
